title: Print the trip sheet and find the user guide
summary: The requester prints the sheet for a trip and opens the user guide from the trips page.
menuPath: My trips > Request a trip; trip page > Print trip sheet; My trips > User guide
processing: The trip sheet is made from the trip and its history; nothing is stored.
evaluation: The requester checks the sheet before the trip.
documents: Trip sheet (print page); user guide (PDF and Word).
closure: The sheet is printed or saved as PDF.

exceptions.when: The trip belongs to someone else
exceptions.then: The sheet is not shown (trip not found).

steps.action: Find the Print trip sheet button under History
steps.label: Print trip sheet
steps.expect: The button 'Print trip sheet' is shown

steps.action: Go back to My trips and click User guide
steps.label: User guide
